validity.researcher_notes: P6773 is a genuine compression/looping expansion of the LEAP gathering system, increasing Haynesville takeaway capacity. Phase 2 was announced in 2023, entered construction in Oct 2023, achieved mechanical completion in Dec 2023, and became operational Jan 1, 2024. EIA confirms 400 MMcf/d incremental capacity. All core specs confirmed: status operating, in-service 2024, capacity 400 MMcf/d. No new physical pipeline (LengthKnown=0 is correct). Operator is DT Midstream. Intrastate Louisiana gathering system. No duplication: distinct from Phase 1 (P5114, 300 MMcf/d, 2023), Phase 3 (P6842, 200 MMcf/d, 2024), and Phase 4 (P6843). Caveat: existing refs to EIA data.php are navigation pages (forbidden); replaced with dated EIA release. No route geojson (null); confirmed Haynesville->Gulf Coast LNG via operator page.
